title: Nuclear spins are the exception to fast decoherence in the wet brain

statements.text: Small molecules and ions in the wet brain lose quantum coherence quickly to their surroundings, with one exception: nuclear spins couple so weakly to the environment that coherence times of minutes or longer are possible.

sources.quote: Nuclear spins are so weakly coupled to the environmental degrees of freedom that, under some circumstances, phase coherence times of five minutes or perhaps longer are possible
